integrity: The source code performs exhaustive exact arithmetic, and the two exceptional sphere types also admit explicit geometric join/cone arguments. One related historical full article was unavailable for in-depth literature comparison; independent audit remains outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete mod-two Betti spectrum only for all subfamilies of the 12 lines of AG(2,3); does not establish integral homology, full persistence maps, arbitrary homotopy types or an infinite-family theorem. The complete-case Betti numbers were known.
title: Complete mod-two homology spectra of ternary affine-plane line erasures
